author: vision9074
releaseNotes: 1.0.0 - Initial release. Parent app handles Mila cloud login, device discovery and polling; child driver exposes air quality, temperature, humidity, CO2, CO, VOC and particulate sensors plus fan control and Mila's smart modes.

apps.name: Mila Air Integration
apps.description: Parent app: holds the Mila account credentials and OAuth token, discovers appliances, polls the Mila GraphQL API and issues all commands.

drivers.name: Mila Air Purifier
drivers.description: Child driver: one device per Mila purifier, exposing its sensors, fan control and smart modes.
